title: crate-jmap pins ICU4X at ~2.2; move its icu_* pins to 2.4 so dependents can use current ICU
description: crate-jmap 391971c7 (2026-11-15) pinned icu_segmenter = "~2.2" (and icu_casemap/icu_normalizer at 2.2) so its tree has one Unicode version. The tilde forbids 2.3/2.4, and ICU4X crates pin siblings to the same minor, so every dependent is forced to 2.2 for the whole family (mimid had 2.4 via idna/url and had to move down in the crate-jmap 83a08405 bump). Proposal: move all three crate-jmap pins to 2.4 (keeping the one-version rule), then cargo update icu_* in mimid. A crate-jmap write: needs Mark's OK, and coordinate with the crate-jmap session.
notes: crate-jmap 946e1070: icu_segmenter now "2.2" (any 2.x >= 2.2). mimid: re-pin to >= 946e1070 and cargo update the icu_* crates to 2.4 once the running agents (srv-blob-sigint, mlsrs-removal, js-lang, hub-metadata-caps) have merged, to avoid lockfile conflicts. Same range has bcb2a67f: ChatLimits defaults max_custom_emoji_per_space=100, max_custom_emoji_bytes=262144 (guide §2.2); mimid's limits() inherits them, which is fine.
close_reason: Done: crate-jmap 946e1070; mimid pinned f35cb6df with icu_* 2.4.0.
